name: Flower letters
source:
Flower letters is an intense psychological game about returning to your hometown after failing your literature degree. You find yourself immersed in a world of chance encounters. You'll enjoy the freedom and diversity of the people you meet, but soon your life takes a dark turn when one of your encounters becomes a nightmare.

An ordinary person won't make you suspect they're developing an obsession with you. As time goes on, you'll start receiving flower-made letters every night, anonymous letters from a obsessed psychopath.

Will you manage to escape from this nightmare?

[From [url=https://yamie-es.itch.io/flowerletters]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《花信》是一款关于文学学位失败后返回家乡的激烈心理游戏。你发现自己沉浸在一个充满偶然相遇的世界中。你会享受你遇到的人的自由和多样性，但很快你的生活就会发生黑暗的转变，因为你的一次遭遇变成了一场噩梦。

一个普通人不会让你怀疑他们对你产生了痴迷。随着时间的推移，你每天晚上都会开始收到鲜花制作的信件，来自一个痴迷的精神病患者的匿名信。

你能成功逃离这场噩梦吗？

[来自[url=https://yamie-es.itch.io/flowerletters]Itch.io[/url]]
